description: QuEra Aquila analog MERA protocol design and cost estimate for holographic force + TEE joint measurement

aquila_specs.platform_type: ANALOG - no discrete single-qubit gates; global Omega(t), Delta(t) pulses + local detuning

mera_16q_analog_protocol.tweezer_geometry: 1D chain with bond sites offset in 2D plane for blockade isolation
mera_16q_analog_protocol.feasibility: MARGINAL - within T2* but tight; Floquet echo recommended
mera_16q_analog_protocol.key_physics: Blockade constraint naturally implements nearest-neighbor MERA isometry; no gate compilation needed
mera_16q_analog_protocol.comparison_to_digital: Helios uses 56 discrete CX gates; Aquila encodes same entanglement structure via 3 analog pulse layers
mera_16q_analog_protocol.encoding_note: MERA bond dimension chi=2 maps to nearest-neighbor blockade exclusion. chi=3 requires 3-atom cluster geometry.

hyp017_force_budget.publication_threshold: alpha = 4.0 +/- 0.5, dr=2..5 above shot noise at 3-sigma

hyp020_tee_marginal.method: Kitaev-Preskill tripartite mutual information on same atomic array
hyp020_tee_marginal.measurement: Computational basis readout of all 16 boundary qubits simultaneously

circuit.note: Analog circuit; structure encoded in tweezer geometry and pulse sequence

comparison_note: Aquila analog errors (3-8%) larger than Helios (0.57%) but tests DIFFERENT physics: blockade dynamics vs gate-based MERA. Complementary, not redundant.
recommendation: Proceed. Joint HYP-017+020 run. Main risk: T2* = 4us leaves 1.2us headroom. Mitigation: Floquet dynamical decoupling. Access via AWS Braket, no partnership required.
